URL: https://financialpost.com/pmn/business-pmn/gilts-climb-as-investors-await-more-policy-details-from-burnham
NOTE: Bloomberg wire (Tue 21 Jul 2026, carried via Financial Post). Bloomberg = APPROVED. UK gilts steadied/recovered Tuesday: 10-year yields down 2bp to 5.01%, 30-year down 3bp to ~5.72%, after Monday's selloff (10Y had hit 5.04%, highest in G7; 30Y 5.75%). Recovery supported by weak UK data: earnings unexpectedly slowed to 4.3% in May, private-sector wage growth dipped to lowest since 2020, dimming bets on higher BoE rates. Citigroup strategist Jamie Searle: "The uncertainty facing gilts switches from political to policy... The countdown clock to the next Budget now begins as only then will the full borrowing implications emerge." Monday selloff followed Burnham's "any flexibility" borrowing remark. Cross-ref techtimes.com (Bloomberg/Euronext cite) same figures.
